alt: The agent loop runs perceive, think, act, and remember in sequence and returns to perceive until the task is complete or a stop condition ends the run. Think passes a tool call to act, and act passes the tool result to remember. Infinite loops start in act; context exhaustion and lost tool results start in remember.
caption: Each phase has its own failure modes, so debug the loop one phase at a time. Payloads are illustrative.
